lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c> covering a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>'s {{upper_body}} (head and
torso). It has a <c:ffff00>skill<c>, an <c:ffff00>action<c> and these <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>:
<c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{uses}}<c>.
Actions can be used only a limited number of times
per <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>. It holds the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> mechanism, so if it
is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> the {{medabot}} is <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>.
When the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> fills, a stat rises by skill:
{{power}} (<c:ffff00>Striking<c>), {{success}} (<c:ffff00>Shooting<c>), {{cooldown}}
(<c:ffff00>Support<c>, <c:ffff00>Set-up<c>) or {{prep}} (<c:ffff00>Heal<c>, <c:ffff00>Block<c>).
